name: PMA
toxicity: can be considered extremely toxic when compared to other substances such as Methamphetamine or MDMA
Ingestion of PMA has been associated with severe tachycardia (abnormally high heart rate), seizures, hyperthermia, and death
summary: An empathogen with a slow onset and strong serotonin release. This, combined with its lack of dopamine release, often leads users to dose more for the pleasurable effects which reportedly do not appear. This often leading to hospitalisations and deaths. The drug has been missold as MDMA.
advisory: Ingestion of PMA has been associated with severe tachycardia (abnormally high heart rate), seizures, hyperthermia, and death.
